records.name: Coda
records.one_liner: Doc-as-app: docs with powerful tables, formulas and packs.
records.auth_detail: OAuth2 for packs/integrations; account access tokens (Bearer).
records.access_detail: Free tier; token self-serve in account settings.

records.name: Smartsheet
records.one_liner: Spreadsheet-style work execution platform with automation.
records.auth_detail: OAuth2 (preferred) + legacy access tokens (Bearer).
records.access_detail: Trial then paid plans (Pro/Business/Enterprise); API access on paid tiers.

records.name: Harvest
records.one_liner: Time tracking with invoicing and expense reports for teams.
records.auth_detail: OAuth2 + personal access tokens (Bearer).
records.access_detail: Free plan (1 seat, 2 projects); PAT self-serve.

records.name: Stripe
records.one_liner: Payments, billing and financial infrastructure API.
records.auth_detail: Secret/restricted keys (Bearer) + OAuth2 for connect-platform apps.
records.access_detail: Free account; test-mode keys instantly, live keys after quick verification.
records.mcp_detail: Stripe Apps/Agent Toolkit + official MCP (2025).

records.name: Plaid
records.one_liner: Bank-account connectivity and financial data APIs (Link flow).
records.auth_detail: client_id/secret per request + access_token (Bearer) minted via Link public_token exchange; OAuth redirect support.
records.access_detail: Free developer sandbox self-serve; production keys after quick approval.

records.name: Binance
records.one_liner: Crypto exchange: spot/futures/earn REST + WebSocket APIs.
records.auth_detail: API key + HMAC-SHA256 signed requests (timestamped, recvWindow) — signed-hmac category.
records.access_detail: Any verified account creates keys free.

records.name: Paygent Connect
records.one_liner: White-label payments gateway (NMI-powered) — reseller layer, not a dev platform.
records.auth_detail: Underlying NMI gateway uses security_key / USER.PRIVATEAPIKEY or Bearer merchant API key; Paygent Connect itself publishes no auth docs.
records.access_detail: Merchant accounts via Paygent sales/ISO; no public developer portal found in search.
records.blocker: APP DEFEATED US: no discoverable developer docs for Paygent Connect itself (NMI white-label reseller). Build against NMI (docs.nmi.com) only if you hold a merchant account.

records.name: iPayX
records.one_liner: FX forensic-audit layer for B2B payments (hidden markup detection).
records.auth_detail: FX Audit MCP server is open (no auth, 3 free calls/month per IP); REST per ipayx.ai/docs uses standard key auth.
records.access_detail: MCP usable immediately without credentials; dashboard at app.ipayx.ai.
records.mcp_detail: iPayX Technologies mcp-fx-audit (official GitHub org).

records.name: QuickBooks
records.one_liner: Intuit small-business accounting (QuickBooks Online) with accounting APIs.
records.auth_detail: Intuit OAuth2 (OIDC-ish authorization code + refresh).
records.access_detail: Sandbox self-serve free; production needs app review + a paid QuickBooks Online subscription.
records.blocker: Approval: Intuit app review + customer's paid QBO plan for production use.

records.name: Xero
records.one_liner: Cloud accounting for SMBs (invoices, payroll, projects).
records.auth_detail: OAuth2 (PKCE) for user-context apps; JWT key-pair custom connections (2-legged).
records.access_detail: Free trial org + always-on demo company; real orgs need a paid plan; custom connections free to create.
records.mcp_detail: Official XeroAPI/xero-mcp-server (self-hosted stdio, run with dev credentials) — not a hosted endpoint.

records.name: Brex
records.one_liner: Corporate cards, spend management and banking for startups.
records.auth_detail: User tokens (Bearer) from the dashboard for direct use + OAuth2 authorization-code / client-credentials for partners and onboarding APIs.
records.access_detail: Requires an approved Brex account (company eligibility) + admin-granted token; onboarding is account-reviewed.
records.blocker: Account gate: Brex customer eligibility + admin token issuance.

records.name: Ramp
records.one_liner: Corporate cards and spend-management platform with broad REST API v2.
records.auth_detail: OAuth2 (authorization code) for public apps; sandbox keys / restricted keys for private use.
records.access_detail: Sandbox keys self-serve; production publishing goes through partner review; Ramp account itself approval-based.
records.blocker: Partner review for public apps; account eligibility gates live data.

records.name: PitchBook
records.one_liner: Private-market data (companies, deals, funds) with a contract-only research API.
records.auth_detail: Custom Authorization token on api.pitchbook.com — provisioned only after contract signature.
records.access_detail: Direct Data product: separate paid contract via sales; no public docs, no sandbox, no free trial of the API.
records.blocker: Outreach + budget: separate enterprise Direct Data contract; API undocumented publicly.

records.name: NotebookLM
records.one_liner: Google's grounded-AI notebook over your documents (consumer/workspace).
records.auth_detail: No programmatic auth — product has no public API. The 'Enterprise API' hint points at Gemini/Vertex AI, a different product.
records.access_detail: Use via UI only; Workspace Labs/Enterprise tiers change features, not API access.
records.mcp_detail: Community hacks (browser automation) exist; nothing official.
records.blocker: No API at all. Treat Gemini API as a different app if the intent is LLM access.

records.name: Otter AI
records.one_liner: Meeting transcription/notes with search and AI chat (Otter.ai).
records.auth_detail: MCP at mcp.otter.ai uses OAuth (read-only tools); Public API is Enterprise-gated with API keys.
records.access_detail: MCP connectable from almost any account; Public API requires Enterprise + support team provisioning.
records.mcp_detail: Official hosted MCP (3 tools: get user info, search, fetch transcript).
records.blocker: Split surface: MCP is read-only/self-serve; rich REST API is Enterprise-only.

records.name: Fathom
records.one_liner: AI meeting recorder: transcripts, summaries, action items, CRM sync.
records.auth_detail: API key from Settings > API Access (Bearer); webhooks available.
records.access_detail: Public API + webhooks opened to all users (Oct 2025); free plan exists.
records.mcp_detail: Community fathom-mcp (transcripts/summaries/actions).

records.name: Consensus
records.one_liner: AI-powered evidence-based research search over scientific papers.
records.auth_detail: MCP (mcp.consensus.app) uses OAuth2; enterprise REST uses Bearer API key. Careful: goconsensus.com is a DIFFERENT 'Consensus' (demo platform).
records.access_detail: MCP OAuth self-serve via connector directories; REST API keys 'contact us' enterprise.
records.mcp_detail: Official MCP at mcp.consensus.app/mcp (OAuth). NOTE: search indexes still serve a stale docs.consensus.app/docs/mcp URL — evidence churn example.
records.blocker: Enterprise gate on REST; MCP path exists for search/fetch (name collision with goconsensus.com is a research trap).

records.name: Reducto
records.one_liner: Document-parsing API (PDFs/complex docs → clean structured chunks).
records.auth_detail: Bearer API key (REDUCTO_API_KEY) from studio.reducto.ai — instant self-serve, 15k free credits.
records.access_detail: Free credits on signup; dashboard keys.

records.name: Devin
records.one_liner: Autonomous AI software engineer (sessions, playbooks, knowledge).
records.auth_detail: Personal API keys (apk_user_) and org service keys (cog_); Bearer + X-Org-Id for enterprise.
records.access_detail: Requires paid Devin subscription/ACUs; keys self-serve in app settings.
records.mcp_detail: Official Devin MCP (mcp.devin.ai): sessions, playbooks, knowledge, schedules.

records.name: Higgsfield
records.one_liner: Generative video/image model platform (50+ models) with async API + CLI.
records.auth_detail: Dual-key scheme: Authorization: Key ${HF_API_KEY_ID}:${HF_API_KEY_SECRET}; async request lifecycle + webhooks.
records.access_detail: Separate API balance/credits (not the web subscription); keys from platform; CLI `higgsfield auth login`.
records.mcp_detail: GitHub org ships CLI + 'developer skills' instead of an MCP server.

records.name: Mermaid CLI
records.one_liner: OSS Node CLI (mmdc) rendering Mermaid diagrams to SVG/PNG/PDF.
records.auth_detail: Local npm binary — no network auth of its own.
records.access_detail: MIT open source via npm/npx; zero credentials.
records.mcp_detail: Mermaid-render MCPs wrap it in various repos.
records.blocker: Not a SaaS API: ship as a local skill/tool (like Composio local toolkits) rather than a hosted toolkit.

records.name: YouTube Transcript
records.one_liner: transcriptapi.com — hosted API pulling YouTube (and more) captions/transcripts.
records.auth_detail: API key header (X-API-Key style) with request-quota credits.
records.access_detail: Free monthly tier; instant signup.

records.name: Grain
records.one_liner: Meeting-capture platform: recordings, transcripts, AI notes, coaching.
records.auth_detail: Workspace Access Tokens (admin-issued) + OAuth bearer tokens; Public-Api-Version header required (v2).
records.access_detail: Workspace API tokens require Business/Enterprise plans; v2 API at developers.grain.com.
records.mcp_detail: Grain MCP integration (clip creation, bulk tagging) per release notes.
records.blocker: Plan gate: workspace tokens on Business+ only.
